Udacity Recommendations with IBM learning project.

Exploring article recommendation strategies

Compare popularity, collaborative filtering and matrix factorization for article discovery.

Python · pandas · NumPy · SVD · Collaborative filtering

The question

Different recommendation methods face different data-sparsity and cold-start constraints.

The work

  • Explore article interactions and construct a user-item matrix.
  • Implement rank-based and user-user collaborative recommendations.
  • Evaluate SVD matrix factorization across different numbers of latent features.

What the repository demonstrates

  • Saved figures expose the gap between training and test behavior as model complexity increases.

What I learned

  • A better training fit does not automatically mean better recommendations for unseen interactions.

Project context

  • Coursework using IBM article-interaction data, not an engagement for IBM.
  • Accuracy is the notebook’s metric; it is not a demonstrated online recommendation uplift.
Source references

This is a curated local case study based on the public project repository, not a rerun of the original analysis.
